title: Is it possible to import maps from RPG Maker 2000 /2003?

posts.author: tarmonster1
posts.body:
I have a couple of maps from RM2K3 and would like to use them in MZ.
Oops, this should probably be in MZ support. Can I move it?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
I gotchu.
Moved to RPG Maker MZ Support.

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body:
There's no native way, as rm2k/3 use .lmu files for their maps and MV/MZ use JSON. I'm also not aware of a community-developed tool to convert one to the other.
Determining the exact structure of an .lmu file would involve reverse-engineering the engine, which I'm pretty sure would be a violation of the terms of use. It's possible people did it in the days before those ones were officially distributed in English, but if they did I didn't catch wind of it at the time.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body: It may be a matter of interpretation, it is possible that you said map, but it refers to the graphic used to draw the maps, known as Tilesets and chipsets in Rm2k.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
The layer logic of Rm2k3 is actually very different from RMMZ, I don't know if it could be converted.
The best idea would be to use a tool that converts Rm2k3 maps into PNG images and uses them as parallax to recreate the maps manually without difficulty. I can't post it here because I don't know how much this affects the terms of use.
(I consider mapping one of the coolest and even relaxing things about RPG Maker)
